name: Eutoria - Immersive Media Player
summary:
# Eutoria — Immersive Media Server Player

**Your media library, in VR on Meta Quest.**

Eutoria is an unofficial media client for Meta Quest. Built with Meta Spatial SDK and Jetpack Compose, it brings your self-hosted media library into a spatial VR interface: sign in, browse movies and shows, open episode details, and start playback without leaving your headset.

Eutoria is compatible with Jellyfin servers. Connect to your own server, then browse movies, shows, seasons, and episodes; view posters, synopse
